{=homestead_placeable_butcherstent_desc}Produces meat or hides from animals and productivity in your homestead.
{=homestead_placeable_hogfarm_desc}Produces hogs and productivity in your homestead.
{=homestead_placeable_chickencoop_desc}A small henhouse. Your resident flock provides a steady daily supply of meat from eggs and culled birds.
{=homestead_placeable_sheepfarm_desc}Produces meat, sheep, wool, and productivity in your homestead.

{=homestead_placeable_flaxfarm_desc}Produces flax and productivity in your homestead.
{=homestead_placeable_grapefarm_desc}A small vineyard producing fresh grapes daily.
{=homestead_placeable_flaxweaver_desc}Converts flax into linen using a loom and spinning wheel. Requires flax in the homestead inventory.
{=homestead_placeable_grainfarm_desc}Produces grain and productivity in your homestead.
{=homestead_placeable_claygatherer_desc}A clay pit with pickaxes for gathering clay from the earth.
{=homestead_placeable_generallight_desc}Light source.
{=homestead_placeable_prisoncage_desc}A wooden holding cage for keeping up to 2 prisoners contained inside the homestead.
{=homestead_placeable_dirtmound_desc}A small mound of raised earth. Purely decorative.
{=homestead_placeable_buildingplot_desc}A wide, flat earthen pad. Purely a foundation — lay it down to give yourself a level surface to place other buildings on.

{=homestead_placeable_supplywagon_desc}A sturdy wagon for hauling camp supplies and materials.
{=homestead_placeable_worktable_desc}A large table for sorting, cutting, and camp work.
{=homestead_placeable_butchertable_desc}A smaller utility table for food prep and rough camp work.
{=homestead_placeable_logbench_desc}A simple bench that makes the camp feel a bit more lived in.
{=homestead_placeable_markettent_desc}A light street tent that works well as a cheap sleeping shelter.
{=homestead_placeable_paintedtent_desc}A painted canvas tent that adds shelter and a little style.
{=homestead_placeable_canopy_desc}A compact canopy that gives a little extra covered space.
{=homestead_placeable_desertshelter_desc}A larger desert-style shelter with enough room for a small family.
{=homestead_placeable_lumberjackcamp_desc}A rough timber camp with work space and stacked logs. Adds productivity and gives workers a place to gather.
{=homestead_placeable_campfire_desc}A small communal fire that adds leisure and gives people somewhere to stand around.
{=homestead_placeable_tablebenches_desc}A shared table with two benches. Adds leisure and provides sitting spots for homestead residents.

{=homestead_placeable_fieldkitchen_desc}A bustling cooking camp with stoves, pots, and prep tables. Adds leisure and a little space, and its hot meals draw folk in — boosting hearth growth in the villages your homestead recruits from.
{=homestead_placeable_aseraitent_desc}A compact Aserai tent that adds a little sheltered living space.
{=homestead_placeable_battaniatent_desc}A Battanian shelter that adds covered sleeping space and visual variety.
{=homestead_placeable_khuzaittent_desc}A steppe-style Khuzait tent with enough space for a growing homestead.
{=homestead_placeable_sturgiatent_desc}A sturdy northern tent that gives the homestead more room and a rough frontier feel.
{=homestead_placeable_handcart_desc}A small cart for moving supplies around the homestead.
{=homestead_placeable_cattlepen_desc}A simple livestock pen. Produces hides daily and occasionally breeds a cow. Adds productivity.
{=homestead_placeable_winecart_desc}A decorative empty trade cart for making the homestead look more lived in.
{=homestead_placeable_horsepaddock_desc}A small horse area with barriers and a trough. Adds productivity and a little extra working space.
{=homestead_placeable_empiretenta_desc}An Empire street tent that adds covered space and visual variety.
{=homestead_placeable_empiretentb_desc}A second Empire tent style for compact housing.
{=homestead_placeable_empiretentc_desc}A larger Empire canopy tent for sheltered homestead living.
{=homestead_placeable_khuzaittentb_desc}A second Khuzait tent style for steppe-flavored housing.
{=homestead_placeable_khuzaitinteriorb_desc}A roomy Khuzait interior tent suitable for a larger household.
{=homestead_placeable_grandbazaartent_desc}A large decorative market tent that adds space and a little prestige.
{=homestead_placeable_barrelstack_desc}A decorative stack of storage barrels.
{=homestead_placeable_storagecorner_desc}A small cluster of barrels, buckets, and pottery for keeping supplies organized.
{=homestead_placeable_taverntable_desc}A dressed table with mugs, plates, and bowls. Adds leisure without needing tiny clutter placement.
{=homestead_placeable_decoratedworktable_desc}A work table dressed with useful camp clutter.
{=homestead_placeable_haycart_desc}A hay cart for animal feed and supply hauling.
{=homestead_placeable_watertrough_desc}A simple trough for animals and camp water.
{=homestead_placeable_hitchingpost_desc}A small horse hitching area for travel and pack animals.
{=homestead_placeable_flowerpottery_desc}A decorative cluster of flowers and pottery for visual appeal.
{=homestead_placeable_arrowbarrel_desc}A siege arrow barrel. In battle, it should let defenders with bows or crossbows refill arrows and bolts.
{=homestead_placeable_clanbanner_desc}A large banner bearing your clan's colors and device, flying proudly over the homestead.
{=homestead_placeable_clanbannerpole_desc}A clan banner mounted on a standing flagpole.
{=homestead_placeable_clanshield_desc}A decorative shield bearing your clan's device, mounted for display.
{=homestead_placeable_warbanner_desc}A battlefield banner for rallying defenders. During homestead battles, friendly troops near it gain morale and slowly recover health.

{=homestead_placeable_trainingfield_desc}A small drill yard where the garrison trains daily. Adds training XP to regular troops and upgrades eligible troops using stored homestead gold and stash items.

{=homestead_placeable_medicaltent_desc}A staffed recovery tent with beds and basic treatment supplies. Improves morale, speeds wounded recovery, and helps offset AI Influence disease morale penalties when that mod is active.
{=homestead_placeable_ballista_desc}A native siege ballista. In homestead attack battles, it should be usable like the defender ballistas in siege scenes.
{=homestead_placeable_sturgiastakes_desc}A low line of sharp wooden stakes for slowing cavalry and shaping the approach to the homestead.
{=homestead_placeable_plankwalla_desc}A rough wooden wall section for quick field defenses.
{=homestead_placeable_plankwallc_desc}A heavier rough plank wall section for blocking approaches.
{=homestead_placeable_siegebarricadea_desc}A larger siege barricade group for creating a real defensive line.
{=homestead_placeable_siegebarricadeb_desc}A wagon-and-plank barricade group for larger homestead defenses.
{=homestead_placeable_battaniaplatform_desc}A raised wooden platform useful for archers or siege weapons.
{=homestead_placeable_woodenplatform2_desc}A large standalone wooden platform for elevated defense placement.
{=homestead_placeable_stonewall_desc}A larger stone wall segment for sturdier defensive cover.
{=homestead_placeable_battaniawall_desc}A tall Battanian-style wall segment for late homestead defenses.
{=homestead_placeable_smithy_desc}A working smithy. Produces one set of tools daily.
{=homestead_placeable_stables_desc}A stable for raising and keeping horses. Gather a founding herd to attract a Stable Master, who will breed mounts and arrange horse races.
{=homestead_placeable_watchtower_desc}An elevated watchtower that improves your homestead's defensive posture.
{=homestead_placeable_storehouse_desc}A large barn-style storehouse. Provides substantial troop space for a growing homestead.
{=homestead_placeable_castlewall_desc}A heavy castle wall segment for fully developed homestead defenses.
{=homestead_placeable_gatehouse_desc}A large gatehouse capstone for turning a mature homestead into a defensible strongpoint.
{=homestead_placeable_commandpavilion_desc}A large command tent for a settled homestead leader and their retinue.
{=homestead_placeable_mastermedical_desc}An expanded physician's tent that improves care, recovery, and morale in a large homestead.
{=homestead_placeable_woodenstairs_desc}A set of walkable wooden stairs. Use them to connect platforms, walls, or elevated terrain to ground level.
{=homestead_placeable_heavywoodenstairs_desc}A sturdier, wider staircase built from heavy timber. Pairs well with the large wooden platforms and castle walls.
{=homestead_placeable_woodenladder_desc}A simple wooden ladder for climbing to elevated positions. Build early to give defenders access to any raised ground.
{=homestead_placeable_smallplatform_desc}A compact elevated platform section. Stack with ramps and railings to build custom wall walks and fighting positions.
{=homestead_placeable_platformplank_desc}A single narrow plank for bridging gaps or extending a walkway. The basic unit of any wall walk or catwalk.
{=homestead_placeable_plankwallb_desc}A medium-height plank wall section. Fills the gap between the light and heavy wall variants for a consistent defensive perimeter.
{=homestead_placeable_ironmine_desc}A crude mine shaft that extracts iron ore from the earth. Stockpile iron early so your Smithy never sits idle.
{=homestead_placeable_fishery_desc}A small fishing hut with nets and barrels. Provides a reliable daily catch to feed the homestead or sell at market.
{=homestead_placeable_saltworks_desc}A brine spring and evaporation setup that draws salt from the ground. Salt trades well and preserves food for the long march.
{=homestead_placeable_potterykiln_desc}A stone-built firing kiln that turns raw clay into finished pottery. Requires clay in the homestead stash. Pairs well with a Clay Gatherer.
{=homestead_placeable_silvermine_desc}A deep shaft mine that yields raw silver ore. Prized for trade on its own, or refined further by a skilled jeweler.

{=homestead_placeable_jewelersworkshop_desc}An artisan's bench where skilled craftspeople refine raw silver into fine ornamental goods and luxury wares. Requires silver and tools from the homestead stash.
{=homestead_placeable_brewery_desc}A working brewery that ferments grain into beer. Beer sells well in any town and keeps your garrison in good spirits. Requires grain in the homestead stash.
{=homestead_placeable_winery_desc}A facility to press and ferment grapes into wine. Requires grapes in the homestead stash.

{=homestead_placeable_navpoint_desc}A flagpole that marks a preferred routing corridor for your troops during battle. Place these in open passages around walls and buildings to guide allies around obstacles more reliably. Hidden during battle by default (toggle in MCM).
{=homestead_placeable_npc_guard_desc}An NPC stands watch here, facing the flag's direction. Blue. Visible only in build mode.
{=homestead_placeable_npc_worker_desc}An NPC works here, cycling through farm/craft chores (digging, scything, washing, etc.). Green. Visible only in build mode.
{=homestead_placeable_npc_onlooker_desc}An NPC watches and cheers here, facing the flag's direction. Yellow. Visible only in build mode.
{=homestead_placeable_npc_musician_desc}An NPC plays music here, facing the flag's direction. Yellow. Visible only in build mode.
{=homestead_placeable_npc_sit_desc}An NPC sits on the ground here, facing the flag's direction. Red. Best placed near a fire, table, or bench. Visible only in build mode.
{=homestead_placeable_npc_lay_desc}An NPC rests seated on the ground here, facing the flag's direction. Red. Best placed near a fire or bedroll. Visible only in build mode.
{=homestead_placeable_racestart_desc}Marks the start and finish line of a horse-race track. Place exactly one per track.
{=homestead_placeable_racegate_desc}A checkpoint gate for a horse-race track. Place several around the loop; racers must pass each in order.
{=homestead_placeable_dogkennel_desc}A simple shelter that attracts stray dogs. Provides homestead defense.
{=homestead_placeable_market_desc}A bustling marketplace where merchants sell their wares, increasing the homestead's productivity and wealth.

{=homestead_placeable_ambassadorhall_desc}A dignified hall for receiving guests and conducting diplomacy. Your Ambassador will work to improve relations with nearby lords, settlement notables, and visiting caravans.

{=homestead_placeable_tavern_desc}A sprawling barn-and-courtyard tavern managed by your Tavern Keeper. Increases leisure for the garrison and draws travellers to the homestead. The Tavern Keeper spawns inside — speaking to them from the homestead menu will bring you inside as well.
